name: echo-text
title: Echo Text
description: A heavy white word with a train of faded, softly blurred copies behind it. The copies lag and stretch as the pointer moves, flare outward on a click, then gather back into one word.
use: A bold hero or section word where movement adds drama without changing the copy.
avoid: The copies smear into an unreadable fan on wide type, and the main effect needs a precise pointer.
a11y: Echo copies are hidden from assistive tech and removed under reduced motion; the trigger is pointer only. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: One crisp white word dominates a pure black stage, with a row of paler duplicates stepping away behind it and dissolving into the dark. The copies grow steadily softer until only a faint smear of light remains.
behaves: Moving the pointer toward a side pulls the copies that way while the front word leads, so the tail stretches and springs back. Clicking throws a few copies outward to fade, and the train vanishes when the pointer leaves.
customise: Set the word with text; echoes, lag, offset, direction, fade, blur, tint and outline style shape the trail. Mode, trail source, click burst, duration, easing and font size are props too.
weight: moderate: Up to twenty-four absolutely positioned text copies are moved each frame while the trail is awake.
